description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two different models, Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis represents training time in seconds, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250000, and tick labels at intervals of 50000. The y-axis represents loss, also with a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The plot shows two lines: the purple line, representing Vanilla, starts at approximately 2.73 and decreases to around 2.50, with a solid line style and diamond markers, exhibiting a steady decline across the x-axis; the red line, representing SepLLM, starts at approximately 2.72 and decreases to around 2.48, with a solid line style and circle markers, also showing a steady decline across the x-axis, with both lines displaying a similar trend of decreasing loss as training time increases.
